author: Humblepizza779
quote: The game is good with Graphics, the story line lacks heavily while i enjoy the open world aspect and the police are also very strong, the games story feels very weird for a Gta6 game it was very very weird the character stuff is odd and the main character is boring. The chores are a bit much as well, and the lucia jason thing is a no go, i miss the trio we had in 5 where the players were started off in a bank heist not a “i need to rob a store for money for a coffee shop” and lucia is an awful girlfriend but the fact its gta and im talking about girlfriend boyfriend drama should say about all you need to know about the game honestly id wait until an online is announced if it ever will be, before considering and if theres an online only version, id say just buy that because the game gets boring fast it reminds me of watch dogs 2 if it had a baby with gta5
